d:
Congress and the INDIA bloc organised a symbolic mock Parliament targeting CEC Gyanesh Kumar. BJP leaders strongly criticised the event and called it a mockery of constitutional institutions. They questioned the opposition’s decision to hold a mock Parliament instead of raising the issue in the actual Parliament. BJP leaders also targeted Rahul Gandhi over the event and challenged the opposition on its allegations against the Election Commission.
So, how did the BJP counter Congress’s mock Parliament?
